steps.text: Confirm the work scope and the equipment to be isolated.
Open and lock every high-voltage isolator for the equipment, following the approved procedure.
Test for absence of voltage at the point of work with a rated tester.
Apply personal locks and tags, and record who holds each lock.
Earth and short the conductors where the approved procedure requires it.
Confirm the battery bank is isolated from charging and load sources.
Check the ventilation and fire-detection status of the battery space.
Record the state of charge and any alarms before entry.
Take a sample from the outlet selected for testing, following the approved sampling procedure.
Test for the parameters set by the applicable potable water standard.
Record results and the action taken if a limit is exceeded.
